expected.raw_text: Interesse an Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vektordatenbanken und Embedding-Techniken
Vertrautheit mit Model Context Protocol (MCP) oder Bereitschaft, sich intensiv einzuarbeiten
Idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit Agent-Frameworks oder Orchestrierung
Optional: Kenntnisse in Model Fine-tuning, Prompt Engineering oder MLOps
Du verstehst sowohl die klassische Backend-Welt als auch KI-Konzepte

parsed.notes:
The KI & ML and Bonus subsections are optional; Persönliche Eigenschaften starts a new, unmarked requirements subsection.
ChromaDB maps to vector-databases under the supplied taxonomy and therefore adds no separate criterion.
GitHub maps literally to git via the supplied alias, not to GitHub Actions. GitLab in the CI/CD-tools list is provisionally mapped to gitlab-ci and flagged for review.
KI-Konzepte in Persönliche Eigenschaften is provisionally treated as required general AI knowledge and mapped to ai-ml; this broad mapping is flagged for review.
Agile-team experience is read literally as asking for agile development practice and placed in unmapped.
No seniority is inferred from Fundierte Erfahrung or Umfassende Erfahrung; neither is an allowed level signal. German is inferred solely from the posting language.
